old: Toward the field's far edge the grass grows rough and tangled and the wandering mix leans Dusk; the ground gets a little more serious the closer you walk to the lair.
new: Toward the field's far edge the grass grows rough and tangled and the wandering Pale prey run harder and take more knocking down; the ground gets a little more serious the closer you walk to the lair, and any Dusk out here stays holed up in the defended pockets.

old: Deeper into the marsh the channels widen and the footing turns to bog; the wandering mix runs Deep out here, and the ground only gets soggier and stronger toward the lair.
new: Deeper into the marsh the channels widen and the footing turns to bog; the wandering mix leans Dusk out here and the Deep meat stays hidden in the defended hollows, and the ground only gets soggier and stronger toward the lair.

old: Found in a deep marsh hollow, patrolling the open water at its centre rather than the banks.
new: Found in a deep marsh hollow, holding the reedy shallows and mud banks at its edge rather than the open water - close enough to the shore that something with no fins can still pick the fight.

old: Holds a rocky outcrop, perched above the surrounding slopes rather than patrolling at ground level.
new: Holds a low rocky outcrop at the foot of the climb, squatting on bare rock anything can walk up to - it never retreats onto the high ground its own claws would open.
